name: Mandiri Jogja Marathon 2027
short_description: A full marathon and multi-distance running event held at Kawasan Candi Prambanan, Yogyakarta, Indonesia on June 20, 2027.
ai_summary: The Mandiri Jogja Marathon 2027 is a full marathon event scheduled for June 20, 2027, organized by Bank Mandiri. Set against the backdrop of Kawasan Candi Prambanan in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, the event offers four distance options: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Scenic venue at the historic Kawasan Candi Prambanan in Yogyakarta
Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km) suit a range of runner abilities
Organized by Bank Mandiri, a major national institution
cons: Registration status has not yet been announced, so entry details are unavailable

research_highlights: The route is AIMS-certified and runs through cultural landmarks such as Candi Plaosan, traditional villages and the Prambanan temple complex, with the 2026 edition tying the course to Yogyakarta's UNESCO-listed Sumbu Filosofis (Philosophical Axis).
Race day starts very early (around 04:25-04:45) to beat the heat, though one 2024 reviewer noted the start time was uncomfortably close to the local Subuh prayer time.
Course details have changed almost every year (a reviewer who has run six editions counted three route changes), so recent-edition road surface and hill profile can differ notably from older reviews.
The 2026 edition drew a record 10,200 runners from 17 countries and used 21 AQUA water stations along the course, more than the roughly 10 stations reported in 2018.
Categories are Marathon (42K), Half Marathon (21K), 10K and 5K Fun Run, with the marathon route in past editions including a notably steep, technical downhill/uphill section around km 28-30.
research_watchouts: One reviewer described the 2024 marathon route as including potholed, patched asphalt and a stretch passing through a mining area.
Heat becomes a factor once the sun rises, especially by the time back-of-pack runners reach the later kilometers, per multiple race reports.

In earlier editions (e.g., 2018) water/aid stations were reported as disorganized and ran out of supplies early on, according to a runner blog, though organization and water-station numbers have since expanded.
The course profile in the Sleman area has included stretches with potholes and pebbles noted in early-edition (2017) night-time running conditions.

faqs.question: When is the Mandiri Jogja Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: The Mandiri Jogja Marathon 2027 is scheduled to take place on June 20, 2027. It is organized by Bank Mandiri and will be held at Kawasan Candi Prambanan in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, offering runners a historic and scenic setting for the race weekend.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distance categories for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km run, and a 5km run, making it accessible to a wide range of runners with different fitness levels and goals.

faqs.question: Where is the Mandiri Jogja Marathon 2027 held?
faqs.answer: The race takes place in the Kawasan Candi Prambanan area of Yogyakarta, Indonesia. This historic setting near the famous Prambanan temple complex provides the backdrop for all four race distances offered as part of this Bank Mandiri-organized running event.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Mandiri Jogja Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: Registration for the Mandiri Jogja Marathon 2027 has not yet been announced. Prospective participants interested in the full marathon, half marathon, 10km, or 5km distances will need to wait for further details from organizer Bank Mandiri regarding sign-up dates and procedures.
